note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs records with destination, HS code and B/L numbers exist, latest 2026-02-28, with a long trading history (16,423 records claimed, 139 counterparties, 68 port lanes) and repeat European buyers. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 621420 (woollen/silk shawls) does not match the observed records — the export row shows HS 62149051 (other cotton shawls) and the import rows show HS 61171020 (knitted cashmere shawls). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (62149051 for cotton shawl exports; 61171020 for cashmere shawl imports) and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. Also note the company is a two-way trader/manufacturer: it imports finished cashmere shawls from Nepal (Tricot Industries, Exclusive Fabric Industries) and re-exports, so role is best described as manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer. Industry claim 'food & FMCG' is wrong — the company is in shawls/apparel textiles. Domestic India sales are unverified (null), not absent: absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation (403s and search outage), not a finding of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures: null, not public in the sources reached.
